title: Complete incomplete JMAP-BLOBEXT informative reference
description: The JMAP-BLOBEXT informative reference (lines 41-43) has only 'title' and 'target' fields — missing 'author', 'date', and 'seriesinfo'. The RFC toolchain (xml2rfc) will warn or error on this incomplete reference. Add author (Bron Gondwana), seriesinfo (Internet-Draft: draft-ietf-jmap-blobext-XX with correct revision), and date.
